About FreeAgentStore

FreeAgentStore is a platform for composable AI agents that run in your browser. Every agent is a JavaScript library you can import into any app — via npm, ESM URL, or as a standalone demo. Free, private, open source.

Why agents, not apps?

Apps are products. Agents are capabilities. A resume parser, a writing assistant, a browser automator — these aren't apps you open and use. They're building blocks that apps import.

When a developer builds a recruiting tool on FreeAppStore, they import @freeagentstore/resume-parser. When they build an email client, they import @freeagentstore/writing-assistant. The agents do the AI; the apps do the UX.

Three tiers of intelligence

Built-in AI

Uses Chrome Gemini Nano / Edge Aion — pre-installed, zero download, instant. Summarizer, Writer, Code Explainer.

Heuristic

Pure JavaScript evolved by LLM from examples. No model at runtime. Resume Parser (94% accuracy from 500 resumes), Sentiment Analyzer.

Model-based

Specialized AI models via WebGPU/WASM. One-time download, cached forever. TTS (Kokoro), Transcriber (Whisper), BG Remover (RMBG).

Trainable, not static

Every agent can be customized for your use case. Upload your data in the Console, Chrome's built-in AI evolves the agent's code/config, and you export a trained version that works exactly for your needs. The Writing Assistant trained on 50 tech company emails produces 87% consistent output in that style.

Privacy by architecture

Nothing leaves your device. Built-in AI runs on Chrome's pre-installed model. Heuristic agents are pure JavaScript. Model-based agents download once and cache locally. There is no server processing your data — ever.
